subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom

Drastic times call for drastic measures

options.text: When you are extremely desperate you need to take extremely desperate actions
Something that ends at the last minute or last few seconds
Don't rely on it until you sure of it
Do not pull all your resources in one possibility

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Drastic times call for drastic measures"** means that during extreme situations, extreme actions are necessary. (अत्यधिक समयों में कठोर कदम उठाने की आवश्यकता होती है)

 
 
• **Example:** When the company was on the verge of bankruptcy, the CEO decided to lay off half of the workforce. Drastic times call for drastic measures.
 
 
 
• **Extreme situations** refer to conditions that are severe and unprecedented, requiring unusual actions. (अत्यधिक परिस्थितियाँ)
 
 
• **Example:** During the flood, the government had to evacuate entire towns to save lives. Extreme situations require extreme actions.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** Something that ends at the last minute or last few seconds (अंतिम मिनट या अंतिम कुछ सेकंड में समाप्त होना)

 
 
• **Example:** The game was a nail-biter, ending in a tie in the last few seconds.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** Don't rely on it until you are sure of it (इस पर तब तक भरोसा न करें जब तक कि आप इसके बारे में निश्चित नहीं हों)
 
 
• **Example:** The deal looks promising, but don't rely on it until the contract is signed.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** Do not pull all your resources in one possibility (सभी संसाधनों को एक ही संभावना में न डालें)
 
 
• **Example:** Diversify your investments; do not pull all your resources in one possibility.
 
 

3a:Tbd6,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
